summary: Core facts match the verified record: coach, roster moves, 52-30, the Lakers loss, Cup Group A, the MLK slot and no Christmas game. The history holds too: Hakeem, Clutch City, DJ Screw, the Comets. The errors were era mix-ups. Fanbase put ketchup and mustard in the Yao/McGrady years, and uniform gave the 1995-2003 redesign the title years. Also fixed: the Truth BBQ pitmaster (Leonard Botello IV), the Screwed Up Records neighborhood, which is South Park, a misattributed chef role and small labels. Still open: small-business status, Johnny Dang's location, Foot Locker/Champs doors, event dates, the City Edition and the MLK home team. The brief overstates the rodeo road trip and assumes a Candy Paint City Edition that can only apply to 2027-28.
